description: Source code for executing and resolving paths for Git commands, including platform-specific methods for determining the executable path and setting up environment variables.

methods.name: system_prefix
methods.description: Determines the system prefix path, platform-specific if RUNTIME_PREFIX is defined.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_from_argv0
methods.description: Resolves executable path from argv[0] if it is an absolute path.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_procfs
methods.description: Resolves executable path via procfs symlink (platform-specific).

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_bsd_sysctl
methods.description: Resolves executable path using BSD sysctl (platform-specific).

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_darwin
methods.description: Resolves executable path on Darwin systems via _NSGetExecutablePath.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_zos
methods.description: Resolves executable path on z/OS systems via program directory and name.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path_wpgmptr
methods.description: Resolves executable path using Windows global variable _wpgmptr.

methods.name: git_get_exec_path
methods.description: Determines the absolute path of the current executable using multiple platform-specific methods.

methods.name: git_resolve_executable_dir
methods.description: Resolves and sets the directory of the current executable.

methods.name: system_path
methods.description: Returns the system path, combining system prefix with relative paths.

methods.name: git_set_exec_path
methods.description: Sets the executable path and propagates it to environment variables.

methods.name: git_exec_path
methods.description: Returns the highest-priority path for Git programs, considering environment variables.

methods.name: add_path
methods.description: Adds a path to a strbuf, normalizing and appending PATH separator.

methods.name: setup_path
methods.description: Sets up the environment PATH variable with the executable path and system PATH.

methods.name: prepare_git_cmd
methods.description: Prepares command argument vector for executing Git commands.

methods.name: execv_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes a Git command with given arguments, replacing current process.

methods.name: execl_git_cmd
methods.description: Executes a Git command with variable arguments, with argument limit.
